mission: Publish the exact canonical NayaNET React/Vite Hub through the existing AppDeploy target with source, artifact, deployment, and runtime provenance.
human_intent: Build exact current main, create immutable artifact identity, transfer the real artifact into AppDeploy without recreating the Hub, and verify desktop/mobile/interaction behavior.
naya_understanding: The canonical Hub is a multi-file React/Vite application. The existing AppDeploy target is a frontend-only snapshot deployment. AppDeploy can build its snapshot, but the build environment did not complete the pinned GitHub-source fetch/build adapter, so the canonical React artifact was not proven transferred.
constraints: Do not claim source equals runtime.
Do not replace the React Hub with an approximation.
Do not promote an unproven artifact.
Keep the existing AppDeploy target live while reconciliation is incomplete.
plan: Create a pinned immutable build path.
Transfer the real artifact into AppDeploy.
Record exact evidence and leave one baton.
actions: Inspected current canonical React entry, AppShellV3, SmartFeedBoard, PIS adapter, identity/session, package and Vite configuration.
Added canonical React build handoff workflow and release marker.
Attempted AppDeploy pinned-source build adapter using exact main commit 56841debb2ea4535cd503307ddaf87676498042b.
AppDeploy rejected the first adapter for snapshot dependency validation; dependencies were repaired and deployment retried.
AppDeploy build still failed at npm run build without exposing a successful artifact/runtime proof.
Rolled AppDeploy back to previously ready snapshot 1789509766843 to preserve the live target.
observations: AppDeploy reports ready after rollback with no frontend or backend errors.
QA snapshot for the restored target reports zero frontend and network errors.
Canonical React source remains distinct from the restored AppDeploy static mirror.
The real React build artifact is not proven in AppDeploy.

evidence.value: mobile and web screenshots; frontend_errors=0; network_errors=0

value.positive: Prevented an unproven or competing React rebuild from being promoted.
value.negative: Canonical React runtime remains unverified at the AppDeploy target.

cost: One AppDeploy build attempt plus dependency repair and rollback.
risk: Further promotion without a real artifact would create false runtime provenance.
failure: AppDeploy npm run build failed after the pinned-source adapter attempt; exact underlying build log was not exposed by the available AppDeploy status surface.
lesson: An AppDeploy frontend-only snapshot cannot be treated as a canonical React artifact merely because the target is READY. The real handoff requires a build environment that can access the exact GitHub source or a separately produced immutable artifact. If that transfer mechanism is unavailable, preserve the live target and record the boundary instead of rebuilding by approximation.

memory.rule: SOURCE → BUILD ARTIFACT → DEPLOYMENT → RUNTIME → INTERACTION must each have independent evidence.
memory.new_intelligence: AppDeploy build-adapter failure is a deployment-environment boundary, not evidence that the canonical React source is broken.

next_action.instruction: Establish a real artifact transport path outside the failed AppDeploy source-fetch adapter: produce the exact canonical React/Vite dist artifact from GitHub main in a verified build environment, then transfer that artifact into the existing AppDeploy snapshot and verify runtime.
